survey.notes: Authoritative title block is clear. Structural reading indicates emergency 24 V DC supply and distribution for radio/navigation/lighting, with GMDSS and emergency battery/charger topology at left, panelized protection in the center, and terminal/relay/load wiring at right. Explicit off-sheet references visible include 'see DWG 111b' near navigation/steaming interfaces, 'see DWG 511b' at alarm module plug B, and 'see DWG 119a' at terminal strip Y. Some small terminal captions, cable/plug annotations, and endpoint text are too fine to verify fully at this resolution; repeated-unit counts are approximate.
